NEWCO es el nombre de la nueva solución de sistemas de Naturgy que integra el nuevo sistema facturador en SAP con un CRM externo en Salesforce. [2]

Los principales aspectos de NEWCO son: [2]

1) Existirá un proceso de sincronización de datos maestros entre SAP y Salesforce para garantizar que la información esté actualizada y sea veraz. [1]

2) SAP ofrecerá servicios web para la actualización de datos maestros, que serán llamados desde Mulesoft (middleware) según los procesos funcionales requeridos. [1]

3) Se definirán los siguientes sectores de suministro para las instalaciones: Gas, Electricidad, Servicios, ServiGas, ServiElectric, ServiHogar, ServiSolar y ServiSeguros. En un mismo punto de suministro se podrán crear N instalaciones (1 Gas, 1 Electricidad, N Servicios). [2]

SAP (Systems, Applications, and Products in Data Processing) is a comprehensive enterprise resource planning (ERP) software suite developed by the German company SAP SE [1]. SAP is designed to manage and integrate a company's core business processes, such as finance, human resources, supply chain, and customer relationship management, into a single, centralized system [1].

The SAP system is widely used by large and medium-sized organizations across various industries, including manufacturing, retail, healthcare, and telecommunications [1]. It provides a range of modules and applications that can be tailored to the specific needs of an organization, allowing for efficient data management, process automation, and decision-making support [1].

Some of the key features and capabilities of the SAP system include financial accounting, controlling, materials management, sales and distribution, production planning, human resources, and project management [1]. The system also offers advanced reporting and analytics tools, enabling organizations to gain insights into their business performance and make informed decisions [1].
